title: Is China Winning the A.I. Race?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个美丽的、有50年历史的文物的微型快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrow-F.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫-F为您报道。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: President Trump is preparing to make a crucial trip to China this week to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正准备在本周对中国进行一次至关重要的访问，与中国国家主席习近平会晤。

sentences.en: A key question hanging over that meeting is artificial intelligence and whether the global race in AI may be spinning out of control.
sentences.zh: 这次会晤悬而未决的一个关键问题是人工智能，以及全球AI竞赛是否正在失控。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: my colleague Vivian Wong explains how China's approaching artificial intelligence differently from the United States and what that means about who's winning the global competition for AI dominance.
sentences.zh: 我的同事维维安·黄将解释中国对待人工智能的方式与美国有何不同，以及这意味着谁正在赢得全球AI主导权的竞争。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月11日，星期一。

sentences.en: Vivian, we've come to you because you've been reporting on China for six years.
sentences.zh: 维维安，我们来找你，是因为你报道中国已经六年了。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And your beat has essentially been AI of late.
sentences.zh: 而且你最近的报道重心基本上就是人工智能。

sentences.en: And I think there is one main question that everyone is asking when it comes to the global AI race.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人在谈到全球AI竞赛时，都会问一个最核心的问题。

sentences.en: And that is, is China beating us?
sentences.zh: 那就是：中国在打败我们吗？

sentences.en: I think that's a really hard question to answer because China and the United States are actually running very different races with different goals and different metrics of success.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很难回答的问题，因为中国和美国实际上在进行着截然不同的赛跑，有着不同的目标和不同的成功衡量标准。

sentences.en: And I think China is very confident that along its chosen path, it is doing very well.
sentences.zh: 我认为中国非常确信，在它选择的道路上，它做得很好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what is that chosen path?
sentences.zh: 那么，这条选择的道路是什么？

sentences.en: Talk to me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: From the beginning, China's strategy when it comes to AI has been putting it in people's hands, putting it in factories, putting it everywhere throughout the economy.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，中国在人工智能方面的战略就是将其交到人们手中，放进工厂里，应用到经济的方方面面。

sentences.en: It's this focus on real world applications.
sentences.zh: 这就是对现实世界应用的专注。

sentences.en: And that's really different from the way that I think Silicon Valley and a lot of American policymakers talk about AI, which is generally revolving around AGI, right?
sentences.zh: 这与我认为硅谷和许多美国政策制定者谈论AI的方式截然不同，他们通常围绕着通用人工智能（AGI）展开，对吧？

sentences.en: This idea that AI is building towards this super powerful, super human intelligence.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为人工智能正在朝着超级强大、超越人类的智能发展。

sentences.en: Whereas China and Chinese policymakers have always kind of talked about AI as this way towards making the economy run better.
sentences.zh: 然而中国和中国的政策制定者一直把人工智能看作是让经济运转得更好的一种途径。

sentences.en: So if you just walk around on the street in China, you are going to encounter different manifestations of AI everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你走在中国的大街上，你到处都会遇到人工智能的不同体现。

sentences.en: There are driverless cars in a ton of Chinese cities.
sentences.zh: 在中国的许多城市里都有无人驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: There are robots everywhere from restaurants to just patrolling the streets to definitely, of course, in factories.
sentences.zh: 到处都有机器人，从餐馆到街头巡逻，当然还有工厂里。

sentences.en: And people have found ways to use it in places that we might never have imagined.
sentences.zh: 人们已经找到了在那些我们可能从未想象过的地方使用它的方法。

sentences.en: I recently talked to a few different parents who have thought of really creative ways to use AI in their children's educations.
sentences.zh: 我最近采访了几位不同的家长，他们想出了非常富有创造力的方法，将人工智能融入孩子的教育中。

sentences.en: I like myself.
sentences.zh: 就像我自己一样。

sentences.en: One mom had bought this AI contraption that was basically a translation mask that she would wear to help her kids practice speaking English.
sentences.zh: 一位妈妈买了一个人工智能小玩意儿，基本上是一个翻译面具，她戴着它来帮助孩子们练习说英语。

sentences.en: A translation mask.
sentences.zh: 一个翻译面具。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really looks like the mask that Bane wears in the Batman movies.
sentences.zh: 对，它看起来真的很像蝙蝠侠电影里贝恩戴的面具。

sentences.en: Mommy, hold your neck.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，抱抱你的脖子。

sentences.en: And the way it works is that she would speak into it in Chinese.
sentences.zh: 它的工作原理是，她用中文对着它说话。

sentences.en: And then what would come out was a version of her voice but speaking English.
sentences.zh: 然后出来的就是她自己声音的英文版。

sentences.en: I like you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你。

sentences.en: Mommy, I love you too.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我也爱你。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so she would just wear it around the house to talk to her kids.
sentences.zh: 所以她就会戴着它在家里和孩子们说话。

sentences.en: What are you eating?
sentences.zh: 你在吃什么？

sentences.en: You have to really love AI to, like, put on a Bane mask to talk to your kid.
sentences.zh: 你必须极其热爱人工智能，才会为了和孩子说话而戴上贝恩的面具。

sentences.en: I mean, I just can't totally imagine it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我简直无法想象。

sentences.en: But that's commitment.
sentences.zh: 但这真是全情投入。

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 对，

sentences.en: I think that what's been really striking to me about observing just the way that people in China are talking about and thinking about AI is people are really excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我认为观察中国普通人谈论和思考人工智能的方式，最让我震惊的是，大家对此都感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, in America, when people talk about AI, there's this whole doomer conversation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在美国，当人们谈论人工智能时，总有一种末日论调。

sentences.en: A lot of people are really nervous about it, you know, either taking their job or taking over the entire world.
sentences.zh: 很多人对此感到非常紧张，你知道，要么担心工作被抢，要么担心人工智能接管整个世界。

sentences.en: And that conversation is just a lot quieter in China.
sentences.zh: 而在中国，这种讨论要安静得多。

sentences.en: Okay, so when you say that China feels like it's doing pretty well given the path that it's taken on AI,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以当你提到中国觉得自己在走上AI之路后表现得相当不错时，

sentences.en: what you mean by that is making people kind of fall in love a little bit with AI, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，这让人们对人工智能产生了一点爱意。

sentences.en: And also making it so that AI is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 同时也让人工智能无处不在。

sentences.en: Yeah, China is really focused on how AI can be useful to them now.
sentences.zh: 是的，中国非常专注于人工智能现在能对他们起到什么作用。

sentences.en: And that comes in part because China has a lot of really deep structural issues that without AI, I think they really don't have a way to solve.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，中国有许多深层的结构性问题，如果没有人工智能，我认为他们真的没有办法解决。

sentences.en: So, for example, the population and the workforce are aging really quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，人口和劳动力正在迅速老龄化。

sentences.en: And how do you solve that if young people don't want to have children?
sentences.zh: 如果年轻人不想生孩子，你该如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: Well, maybe using AI to make your factories more efficient.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许可以通过使用人工智能来提高工厂效率。

sentences.en: Another problem is huge inequities between access to health care in rural and urban areas.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是城乡医疗资源获取方面的巨大不平等。

sentences.en: If you don't have enough doctors, how do you solve that?
sentences.zh: 如果没有足够的医生，你如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: Maybe AI doctors are the answer.
sentences.zh: 也许人工智能医生就是答案。

sentences.en: So it sounds like, in a sense,
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，从某种意义上说，

sentences.en: there may be quite a bit riding on AI from the Chinese government's perspective if it's being seen as a potential solution to all these really important probleMs.
sentences.zh: 如果人工智能被视为所有这些极其重要问题的潜在解决方案，那么中国政府可能会在它身上押下重注。

sentences.en: I think so, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想是的，是的。

sentences.en: The Chinese government historically has always been quite optimistic about technology.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，中国政府对技术一直相当乐观。

sentences.en: I mean, if you look at the past few decades, technology has been a big part of what has powered China's amazing economic rise.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你回顾过去几十年，技术一直是推动中国经济惊人崛起的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: And so I think they see AI as basically the latest iteration of some kind of technology that is going to help them on this global ascent and is going to solve these problems that they have.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们将人工智能基本上视为某种能够帮助他们实现全球崛起的最新一代技术，并将其用来解决他们所面临的问题。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So when does that relationship between the Chinese government and AI actually begin?
sentences.zh: 那么，中国政府与人工智能之间的这种关系实际上是什么时候开始的？

sentences.en: What's that story?
sentences.zh: 背后的故事是什么？

sentences.en: So a key moment is in 2014.
sentences.zh: 一个关键时刻是在2014年。

sentences.en: It was early in Xi Jinping's tenure as leader of China.
sentences.zh: 那是习近平担任中国领导人初期的事。

sentences.en: And he was giving a speech to a gathering of some of China's top engineers and scientists.
sentences.zh: 当时他在一次中国顶尖工程师和科学家的集会上发表讲话。

sentences.en: And he had gotten a bunch of reports from the scientists ahead of time, kind of giving him suggestions on what, you know, they thought China's next direction in science should be.
sentences.zh: 他提前收到了科学家们的一堆报告，里面提出了一些建议，关于他们认为中国科学的下一个方向应该是什么。

sentences.en: And Xi gets up there and he gives a speech and he says, oh, thank you so much for all of your suggestions.
sentences.zh: 习近平走上讲台发表讲话，他说，非常感谢你们所有的建议。

sentences.en: I read them all.
sentences.zh: 我都读了。

sentences.en: And I was really interested in this one report that said intelligent robots are going to be a really big deal going forward.
sentences.zh: 我对其中一份报告非常感兴趣，该报告称智能机器人将在未来发挥极其重要的作用。

sentences.en: And he basically says, I want China to be on top of that.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，我希望中国能够走在前列。

sentences.en: I want China to be the number one maker of intelligent robots.
sentences.zh: 我希望中国成为智能机器人的头号制造商。

sentences.en: And I also want us to dominate all sorts of other technologies that are going to be the future.
sentences.zh: 我还希望我们在所有其他将成为未来的技术中占据主导地位。

sentences.en: And this turns into a plan in 2017 that is called China's new generation AI development plan, which is their first national level roadmap of what they are going to do with AI.
sentences.zh: 这在2017年转化成了一项计划，被称为《新一代人工智能发展规划》，这是他们关于如何处理人工智能的首个国家级路线图。

sentences.en: And it sets out a goal that says they want China to be a leading AI power by 2030.
sentences.zh: 它设定了一个目标，即希望中国在2030年成为领先的AI强国。

sentences.en: And it also says that the way it's going to get there is through real world applications.
sentences.zh: 它还指出，实现这一目标的途径是通过现实世界的应用。

sentences.en: And given how things typically go in China, from my understanding, I'm assuming that what happens next is what always happens when they have a plan,
sentences.zh: 鉴于中国事情通常的发展方式，据我所了解，我猜接下来发生的就是他们制定计划时一贯的做法，

sentences.en: which is that they pour boatloads of money into it, into supercharging it.
sentences.zh: 那就是投入大量的资金，全力推进。

sentences.en: Am I right?
sentences.zh: 我说的对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: It kind of sets the gears of government going at all levels.
sentences.zh: 这就像是启动了政府各个层面的齿轮。

sentences.en: So after this national plan comes out, then you have the provincial and local governments sort of falling over themselves to show how they are complying.
sentences.zh: 所以在国家计划出台后，各省市地方政府便争先恐后地表明他们是如何落实的。

sentences.en: Yongjiao is attempting to recreate a Silicon Valley-style work environment in Beijing's Zhuangguansun district.
sentences.zh: 永交正试图在北京中关村地区重建一个硅谷风格的工作环境。

sentences.en: So they start building industrial parks to attract top companies.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始建设产业园来吸引顶尖企业。

sentences.en: They start giving tax breaks and sort of free or cheap rent to these companies.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向这些公司提供税收减免以及免费或廉租的场地。

sentences.en: It was a good decision to come back to China.
sentences.zh: 回国是一个正确的决定。

sentences.en: I think it's easier to get funding here than in Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在这里比在硅谷更容易获得资金。

sentences.en: And they start giving them money to attract the top talent.
sentences.zh: 他们开始提供资金来吸引顶尖人才。

sentences.en: It's really this all-in national effort to deliver.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场全力以赴的全国行动来兑现目标。

sentences.en: And what's the effect of that?
sentences.zh: 那带来的效果是什么呢？

sentences.en: So for a few years, China really feels like it has the lead in AI.
sentences.zh: 所以在几年时间里，中国确实觉得自己占据了人工智能的领先地位。

sentences.en: Police in Beijing have been wearing these glasses that can recognize faces linked to the government's national database.
sentences.zh: 北京的警察一直戴着这种可以识别人脸并与政府国家数据库相连的眼镜。

sentences.en: You can tell whether it is an adult, a child, a male or female.
sentences.zh: 你可以分辨出那是成年人、儿童、男性还是女性。

sentences.en: How advanced is this technology?
sentences.zh: 这项技术有多先进？

sentences.en: This is a cutting edge.
sentences.zh: 这是最尖端的。

sentences.en: Especially at the time, they were really focused on developing technologies like facial recognition and voice recognition.
sentences.zh: 特别是在当时，他们真正专注于开发人脸识别和语音识别等技术。

sentences.en: And Chinese companies really were at the forefront of this.
sentences.zh: 中国公司确实走在了最前沿。

sentences.en: They were some of the best in the world.
sentences.zh: 他们是世界上最优秀的几家公司。

sentences.en: And this was, of course, also really useful for China's surveillance apparatus.
sentences.zh: 当然，这对于中国的监控体系来说也非常有用。

sentences.en: We're trying to transform our economic model from made in China to created in China.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图将经济模式从“中国制造”转变为“中国创造”。

sentences.en: But then in 2022, ChatGPT comes on the scene.
sentences.zh: 但随后在2022年，ChatGPT登上了舞台。

sentences.en: ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT。

sentences.en: ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT。

sentences.en: ChatGPT is technology accessible and free to anyone on the web that impersonates what is read on the internet.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT是一种对网络上任何人都是无障碍且免费的技术，它能够模仿互联网上阅读到的内容。

sentences.en: This promises to be the viral sensation that could completely reset how we do things.
sentences.zh: 这有望成为一个病毒式的轰动现象，彻底重塑我们做事的方式。

sentences.en: And that really caught Chinese policymakers and Chinese tech companies off guard.
sentences.zh: 这确实让中国的政策制定者和科技公司措手不及。

sentences.en: It caught everybody off guard.
sentences.zh: 它让所有人都措手不及。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: And for China, I think it was a moment that made them sit back and think, okay, we thought we had the lead on AI when it came to facial recognition.
sentences.zh: 对于中国来说，我认为这是一个让他们坐下来思考的时刻，好吧，我们原本以为在人脸识别方面我们在人工智能上占据了领先地位。

sentences.en: But here is this completely different area, generative AI, that they had not been thinking about as much.
sentences.zh: 但这里出现了另一个完全不同的领域——生成式人工智能，这是他们之前没有怎么考虑过的。

sentences.en: And it kind of scares the Chinese government because generative AI, you know, it's this thing that is looking at all of the information on the internet.
sentences.zh: 这让中国政府感到有些恐慌，因为生成式人工智能，你知道的，它是一种能够查看互联网上所有信息的事物。

sentences.en: It's coming up with answers that are sort of unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 它得出的答案某种程度上是不可预测的。

sentences.en: And the Chinese government becomes really nervous that this is going to be a threat to their information controls, their censorship regime.
sentences.zh: 中国政府开始变得非常紧张，担心这会对其信息控制和审查制度构成威胁。

sentences.en: You know, they don't want Chinese people plugging questions about politically sensitive events into a chatbot and getting answers that they don't want the people to be getting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们不希望中国人向聊天机器人输入关于政治敏感事件的问题，并得到政府不希望人民得到的答案。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So they're looking at this as a potential threat to their political model.
sentences.zh: 所以他们将此视为对其政治模式的潜在威胁。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I think that, you know, they had been thinking about AI as this really powerful tool for the economy and in some ways to solidify their grip on political control.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，他们曾将人工智能视为促进经济发展的强大工具，并在某些方面巩固他们对政治控制的掌握。

sentences.en: But here is proof that it also could be a problem.
sentences.zh: 但这里有证据表明它也可能成为一个问题。

sentences.en: And so you see them react.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到他们做出了反应。

sentences.en: ChatGPT is banned in China.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT在中国被禁了。

sentences.en: The Chinese government starts putting out new regulations also on Chinese AI companies that might be working on generative AI.
sentences.zh: 中国政府也开始对可能在从事生成式AI研发的中国人工智能公司出台新的法规。

sentences.en: For example, they quickly roll out a rule that says if any Chinese AI company is building a model that can, quote unquote, mobilize society,
sentences.zh: 例如，他们迅速推出了一项规定，即任何中国AI公司如果构建能够“引爆社会”（编者注：原文如此）的模型，

sentences.en: it has to first pass a series of checks and clearances with the Chinese government before it can be released to the public.
sentences.zh: 在向公众发布之前，必须首先通过中国政府的一系列审查和批准。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What are those checks and clearances?
sentences.zh: 这些审查和批准是什么？

sentences.en: So basically, you have to do safety testing.

sentences.zh: 但也有确保它不会提供有关政治敏感问题答案的因素，比如天安门广场的六四事件

sentences.en: or about China's top leaders that the government might not want Chinese people asking.

sentences.en: It sounds like there's this tension for the Chinese government between wanting to dominate in AI, which now includes this world of generative AI,
sentences.zh: 听起来中国政府面临着一种张力：一方面希望在人工智能领域占据主导地位——现在这其中包含了生成式人工智能的世界，

sentences.en: but also from an authoritarian perspective, wanting to maintain as much control as they can over information, which is so key to powering these models.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，从威权主义的角度来看，又希望尽可能多地保持对信息的控制，而信息正是为这些模型提供动力的关键。

sentences.en: I mean, part of the reason for the success of these chatbots is that they pull from the entire universe of information.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些聊天机器人成功的部分原因在于它们汲取了全人类的信息。

sentences.en: Yeah, and this is a tension that exists in China's entire economic development, where the government knows that to allow its economy to flourish, it needs openness,
sentences.zh: 是的，这种张力存在于中国整个经济发展过程中，政府深知要让经济繁荣，就需要开放，

sentences.en: it needs interaction with the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 需要与世界其他地方进行互动。

sentences.en: But, of course, it also wants that interaction to happen on its own terms and within its own control.
sentences.zh: 但当然，它也希望这种互动能够按照它自己的条件并在其控制范围内进行。

sentences.en: So that tension is just even more pronounced when it comes to AI.
sentences.zh: 所以在人工智能方面，这种张力就更加明显了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so they are trying to maintain that balance, trying to figure out how that works.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在努力维持这种平衡，试图弄清楚它是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And then in early 2025, along comes DeepSeq.
sentences.zh: 然后到了2025年初，DeepSeek横空出世。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Let's talk about DeepSeq, because it is mind-blowing and it is shaking this entire industry to its core.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊DeepSeek，因为它实在太震撼了，正在从根本上撼动整个行业。

sentences.en: The emergence of DeepSeq...
sentences.zh: DeepSeek的出现……

sentences.en: So DeepSeq was the chatbot created by a Chinese startup that really no one had heard of before last year.
sentences.zh: 所以DeepSeek是一家中国初创公司创建的聊天机器人，在去年之前几乎没人听说过它。

sentences.en: And it performed basically just as well as leading models in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它的性能基本上与美国领先的模型不相上下。

sentences.en: DeepSeq says that their AI model only cost $5.6 million.
sentences.zh: DeepSeek表示，他们的AI模型成本仅为560万美元。

sentences.en: Now, we don't...
sentences.zh: 现在，我们并不……

sentences.en: But according to the company's founders, it had been trained for so much cheaper.
sentences.zh: 但据该公司创始人的说法，它的训练成本要低得多。

sentences.en: It was open source.
sentences.zh: 它是开源的。

sentences.en: And to have the Chinese actually open sourcing it, meaning that that is going to be what goes around the world.
sentences.zh: 而且中国实际上将其开源了，这意味着这将成为风靡全球的东西。

sentences.en: Huge, huge step up and change and puts us a little bit on our back foot in trying to figure out...
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大无比的跨越和变革，让我们在试图弄清楚状况时有些措手不及……

sentences.en: And it was this wake-up call and this sign to everybody around the world that Chinese AI could compete with Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 这是一个警钟，也是向全世界发出的一个信号：中国的AI能够与硅谷竞争。

sentences.en: I think Marc Andreessen put it really smartly when he said that this feels like the Sputnik moment for the AI race.
sentences.zh: 我认为Marc Andreessen总结得很精辟，他说这感觉就像是AI竞赛的“斯普特尼克时刻”。

sentences.en: And for all of China and the Chinese government in particular, this is also a moment of huge national pride.
sentences.zh: 对整个中国，尤其是中国政府而言，这也是一个充满巨大民族自豪感的时刻。

sentences.en: Soon after DeepSeq's release, Xi Jinping actually called a meeting of a bunch of business leaders, including the founder of DeepSeq,
sentences.zh: 在DeepSeek发布后不久，习近平实际上召集了一群商界领袖开会，其中包括DeepSeek的创始人，

sentences.en: who's just a guy in his 30s again who most people have never heard of before this point.
sentences.zh: 他也就是个30多岁的小伙子，在此之前大多数人从未听说过他。

sentences.en: And Xi tells the entrepreneurs there, go out and show your talents and serve the country.
sentences.zh: 习近平对那里的企业家说，去吧，展现你们的才华，报效国家。

sentences.en: And this is seen as a really important signal that the government recognized that it needed to give companies a little bit more space if it really wanted them to be on the cutting edge.
sentences.zh: 这被视为一个非常重要的信号，表明政府认识到，如果真的想让企业走在前沿，就需要给它们更多的空间。

sentences.en: And so I think what it's essentially trying to do here is have its cake and eat it too.
sentences.zh: 所以我想它在这里本质上是想鱼与熊掌兼得。

sentences.en: I talked to an analyst who I thought put it really smartly.
sentences.zh: 我采访过一位分析师，我觉得他总结得非常精辟。

sentences.en: He said the Chinese government is trying to control what AI says, but unleash what it does.
sentences.zh: 他说中国政府试图控制AI说的话，但要解放AI做的事。

sentences.en: And so basically, if you are making a chatbot, if you are making some sort of AI product that is going to be feeding information to the Chinese people,

sentences.en: you are going to be under a greater degree of restrictions.
sentences.zh: 你将会受到更大程度的限制。

sentences.en: But if you are doing robotics, if you are doing something that doesn't really deal with information that could directly influence how Chinese people are thinking,
sentences.zh: 但如果你在做机器人技术，如果你在做一些不直接涉及可能影响中国人民思维的信息的事情，

sentences.en: there are a lot fewer restrictions there.
sentences.zh: 那里的限制就会少得多。

sentences.en: And did that meeting, did the new signaling, new messaging around this actually lead to concrete changes that you see in China?

sentences.en: Like, do you see it manifest?

sentences.en: I think so.

sentences.en: I mean, it's hard to say if it came directly from that meeting or just the excitement around DeepSeek in general.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很难说它是直接源于那场会议，还是仅仅源于人们对DeepSeek的整体狂热。

sentences.en: But 2025 and this year have really just been huge moments of development in China's AI scene.
sentences.zh: 但2025年以及今年，确实是中国AI领域大发展的重大时刻。

sentences.en: You've seen a ton of new models getting registered.
sentences.zh: 你会看到大量新模型完成注册。

sentences.en: You've seen a bunch of startups doing really well.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一堆初创公司表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: And that's also where you've seen kind of AI get diffused so broadly into the economy in all the ways that we talked about where everyone's using it all the time.
sentences.zh: 这也是你看到AI以我们讨论过的各种方式广泛融入经济的地方，每个人都在无时无刻地使用它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we see how much they're doubling down on AI just this past March when the Chinese government released its five-year plan,
sentences.zh: 就在今年3月中国政府发布五年规划时，我们看到了他们对AI的双倍押注，

sentences.en: which is this grand economic plan for how China's economy is going to run for the next five years.
sentences.zh: 这是一项宏大的经济规划，关于中国经济未来五年的运行方式。

sentences.en: And this plan mentions AI more than 50 times.
sentences.zh: 这份规划中提及AI的次数超过了50次。

sentences.en: So it's really clear that they are staking basically their entire economic future on dominating AI.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，他们基本上将整个经济未来都押在了主导AI上。

sentences.zh: 在芯片方面，也就是训练AI模型所必需的强大硬件，事实是中国的芯片确实不如美国的强大。

sentences.en: So on chips, which are the powerful hardware that's necessary for training AI models, the fact is that Chinese chips are just not as powerful as American ones.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国的AI公司仍然非常依赖英伟达的芯片来打造他们能做出的最好AI。

sentences.en: So Chinese AI companies are still really reliant on chips from NVIDIA to make the best AI that they can.
sentences.zh: 英伟达是一家美国公司。

sentences.en: NVIDIA, an American company.
sentences.zh: 一家美国公司。

sentences.en: An American company.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 中国已经花费了数千亿美元试图开发国内的高性能芯片，但他们目前还没能做到。

sentences.en: And China has spent hundreds of billions of dollars on trying to develop domestic powerful chips, but they just haven't gotten there yet.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是人才。

sentences.en: And then the other problem is talent.
sentences.zh: 中国每年培养出许许多多极其优秀的AI研究人员。

sentences.en: So China produces many, many, many extremely talented AI researchers every year.
sentences.zh: 但如果没有我们刚才讨论的那种开放、创新的环境，他们中的许多人可能会并且确实会选择去美国。

sentences.en: But without the sort of open, innovative environment that we were just talking about, many of them may choose and do choose to go to the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国公司和政策制定者非常坦诚地讨论了人才短缺是他们必须面对的另一个问题。

sentences.en: And so Chinese companies and Chinese policymakers have talked very openly about how a shortage of talent is another problem that they have to face.
sentences.zh: 这些是中国所面临的相当显著的劣势。

sentences.en: These are pretty significant handicaps that China has.
sentences.zh: 总结一下你刚才所说的话，这里有不利于创新的环境、性能较弱的芯片，以及人才问题。

sentences.en: Just to summarize what you've said, it's an imperfect environment for innovation, less powerful chips, and this talent issue.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，

sentences.en: But at the same time,
sentences.zh: 我们在这场对话的大部分时间里，也都在讨论中国在将AI实用化、融入人们生活以及确保其无处不在方面处于领先地位的种种方式。

sentences.en: we've also spent the better part of this conversation talking about all the ways in which China is ahead in making AI practically useful in people's lives and making sure it is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以，回到我们在开始时纠结的那个问题，中国在世界AI竞赛中胜出了吗？

sentences.en: So just to return to that question that we wrestled with in the beginning of this, is China coming out on top in the global AI race?
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果所有这些AI的最终目的地确实是AGI——那种将统治世界的超人类智能，

sentences.en: I think if the end destination of all of this AI is indeed AGI, this superhuman intelligence that is just going to run the world,
sentences.zh: 那么我确实认为美国公司离那更近。

sentences.en: then I do think American companies are closer to that.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为硅谷更接近技术的前沿。

sentences.en: I do think Silicon Valley is closer to the cutting edge of technology.
sentences.zh: 但必须指出的是，中国并没有落后太多。

sentences.en: But it is important to point out that China is not that far behind.
sentences.zh: 根据大多数专家的估计，它只落后几个月。

sentences.en: It's a few months behind by most experts' estimates.
sentences.zh: 但如果AGI不是终点，我是说，如果它甚至是不可能的，而真正的出路是现在就利用AI来改善我们的日常生活，

sentences.en: But if AGI is not the final destination, I mean, if it's not even possible, and the real way to go is to just use AI to improve our daily lives now,
sentences.zh: 那么我认为中国占据优势，因为它在AI的实际部署上已经远超美国。

sentences.en: then I think China has the edge because it already has deployed AI so much more than the U.S.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是，通过将AI广泛部署到这些机器人和无人驾驶汽车中，

sentences.en: has.
sentences.zh: 它也在源源不断地产生大量新数据，使得这些中国模型每一天都变得更好，

sentences.en: And it's also important to note that by putting AI everywhere in these robots, in these driverless cars,
sentences.zh: 这有助于解决如今AI领域面临的较大问题之一，即训练数据快要耗尽的困境。

sentences.en: it's also generating a bunch of new data all the time that is making these Chinese models even better every single day,
sentences.zh: 中国正在不断为其自身的模型生成新数据。

sentences.en: which helps solve one of the bigger problems in AI these days, which is kind of just running out of training data.
sentences.zh: 中国正在不断为其自身的模型生成新数据。

sentences.en: China is just constantly generating new data for its own models.
sentences.zh: 中国正在不断为其自身的模型生成新数据。

sentences.en: So, at the end of the day, I think that the problem is AI is still so full of so many unknowns.
sentences.zh: 所以，归根结底，我认为问题在于人工智能仍然充满了太多的未知数。

sentences.en: We don't know what the future of this technology is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这项技术的未来会怎样。

sentences.en: We don't know what exactly it means to dominate AI or what it would take to dominate AI.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道主导人工智能到底意味着什么，或者要主导人工智能需要付出什么。

sentences.en: And so it's really impossible to say who is pursuing the right path.
sentences.zh: 因此，要说谁在追求正确的道路，实在是无从谈起。

sentences.en: Vivian, do you think there's a lesson for U.S.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安，你认为中国的应对人工智能的方法对美国

sentences.en: companies in China's approach to AI?
sentences.zh: 公司有什么启示吗？

sentences.en: Because it does seem as though the ambition of reaching toward this superhuman intelligence is so quintessentially American.
sentences.zh: 因为追求这种超人类智能的雄心确实显得非常有美国特色。

sentences.en: It's the biggest, most innovative version of this tech possible.
sentences.zh: 这是这种技术可能展现出的最大、最具创新性的版本。

sentences.en: But it's also potentially backfiring in a sense because it seems to be turning a lot of people against this technology very forcefully.
sentences.zh: 但它也可能在某种程度上适得其反，因为它似乎正在非常强烈地将许多人推向这项技术的对立面。

sentences.en: Whereas focusing on more mundane, maybe less ambitious goals may be a more popular route.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，专注于更世俗、或许不那么雄心勃勃的目标可能是一条更受欢迎的路线。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is a really interesting contrast with the United States where the public hesitation or even pushback to AI is creating, in many ways,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这与美国形成了非常有趣的对比，在美国，公众对人工智能的犹豫甚至抵制，在许多方面

sentences.en: political problems for these AI companies.
sentences.zh: 给这些人工智能公司带来了政治麻烦。

sentences.en: But in China, because people are feeling that this AI is actually tangibly improving their lives, it's making their commute smoother,
sentences.zh: 但在中国，因为人们感觉到这种人工智能确实在切实改善他们的生活，它让他们的通勤更顺畅，

sentences.en: it's making their food get delivered to them faster, it's making products maybe cheaper because factories are more efficient.
sentences.zh: 它让他们的外卖送得更快，由于工厂效率更高，产品可能也更便宜了。

sentences.en: People really feel that this technology could be something that is good for them.
sentences.zh: 人们真的觉得这项技术可能对他们有益。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth noting that we have started to see the conversation in China shift a little bit, especially in recent months.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为值得注意的是，我们已经开始看到中国的讨论发生了一些变化，尤其是在最近几个月。

sentences.en: We have seen people start to talk a little bit more about what happens to my job if AI becomes everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们开始更多地讨论，如果人工智能无处不在，我的工作会怎么样。

sentences.en: But I think that sentiment is still not as maybe prominent as it is in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这种情绪可能不像在美国那样突出。

sentences.en: And actually, that is maybe an interesting result of the government restrictions that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这或许是我们之前谈到的政府限制措施带来的一个有趣结果。

sentences.en: So, yes, on the one hand, they might make it more difficult for Chinese companies to innovate.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，一方面，它们可能会使中国公司创新变得更加困难。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, I think there's a general sense among many Chinese people that the Chinese government will keep this whole sector under control.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，我认为许多中国民众普遍有一种感觉，即中国政府会让整个行业保持在掌控之中。

sentences.en: It will make sure that AI is just not getting out of hand and leaving society totally unstable.
sentences.zh: 它会确保人工智能不会失控，也不会让社会彻底陷入动荡。

sentences.en: And so that also creates a certain degree of trust in the technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也对这项技术产生了一定程度的信任。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think, ironically, in the U.S., the fact that we have this more freewheeling environment when it comes to AI,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，具有讽刺意味的是，在美国，我们在人工智能方面拥有这种更加自由奔放的环境，

sentences.en: there's something about that that makes people more afraid of it.
sentences.zh: 这其中有些东西反而让人们更害怕它。

sentences.en: And that backlash from the grassroots right now, that could end up being a problem down the line for AI development in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而目前来自民间的这种强烈反弹，最终可能会成为未来美国人工智能发展的一个问题。

sentences.en: That could be a headwind.
sentences.zh: 这可能会成为一种阻力。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that could prove to be a real impediment to AI development in America that is probably just not going to play out in the same way in China.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这可能被证明是美国人工智能发展的真正障碍，而在中国可能不会以同样的方式上演。

sentences.en: Well, Vivian, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，薇薇安，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Democrats are scrambling to respond to a Virginia Supreme Court decision on Friday,
sentences.zh: 民主党人正忙于应对弗吉尼亚州最高法院周五做出的一项裁决，

sentences.en: which struck down a new congressional map that would have given the party an advantage in the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 该裁决推翻了一项本可让该党在中期选举中获得优势的新国会选区划分图。

sentences.en: You know, the voters will have their last word on this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，选民将对此做出最后决定。

sentences.en: The fallout of the decision is huge.
sentences.zh: 该裁决的余波是巨大的。

sentences.en: In a private call on Saturday,
sentences.zh: 在周六的一次闭门通话中，

sentences.en: Democratic lawmakers discussed trying to restore the map with a move that would replace the entire state Supreme Court by lowering the age of retirement.
sentences.zh: 民主党议员讨论了试图通过降低退休年龄来取代整个州最高法院，从而恢复选区划分图的举措。

sentences.en: It was unclear how many Democrats would support such a drastic solution.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚有多少民主党人会支持如此极端的解决方案。

sentences.en: And passengers and crew from the cruise ship that was hit by a deadly hantavirus outbreak were evacuated on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 遭遇致命汉坦病毒疫情袭击的游轮上的乘客和船员已于周日撤离。

sentences.en: The ship anchored off the Canary Islands in Spain, where health officials checked the passengers' temperatures and symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 该游轮停泊在西班牙加那利群岛外海，卫生官员在那里检查了乘客的体温和症状。

sentences.en: The Spanish health minister said everyone on board was asymptomatic.
sentences.zh: 西班牙卫生大臣表示，船上所有人都没有出现症状。
